name: amr_faults_showcase
label: Synthetic data. Faults are deliberately introduced to test classification: order lines are forced outside their assured range, and three sensor faults are injected.
description: Fulfilment cell (synthetic data). One input outside its assured range, then three kinds of sensor data-quality fault: order lines forced above the dispatcher's assured range for five ticks; AMR 1's battery-voltage reading stuck; AMR 2's wheel-odometry speed reading dropping out; a spike in the pick station's cycle-time reading.
